Talk.Hello: Welcome! Take your time and look around.
Talk.Etched: The rune is set. See how it glows!
Talk.Creature: A fine beast. Take good care of it!

Shop.Featured: Featured — starred by the GM, shown first
Shop.OpenSheet: Open item sheet (or double-click the row)
Shop.RestockIn: {n} day(s) to the next automatic restock
Shop.PurseHint: What the merchant can spend buying from you. It grows when you buy and refills a little each restock period.

Repair.Hint: Damaged or broken items are restored to full HP. Destroyed items (0 HP) can't be Repaired. To do it yourself, use Crafting's Repair activity (10 minutes, repair toolkit).

Rune.Hint: Etch a rune from the shelf onto your gear (cost: the rune's Price). Property runes need a free slot (one per potency); a greater version replaces the lesser. By the rules etching takes Craft time — the GM decides.
Rune.Unmodelled: PF2e doesn't track this rune on the sheet — buy it as an item and settle it with the GM
Rune.NoSlot: No free property rune slot ({n} slots)
Rune.SameKind: Only between items of the same kind
Rune.TransferHint: Move a rune to another item: 10% of the rune's Price, free from a runestone (GM Core p. 225). Fundamental runes are swapped.

Trade.NoGM: A GM must be online to trade.
Trade.Timeout: No answer. Is a GM online?

Err.NotYours: You can't trade with that character.
Err.NoPurse: The merchant can't afford it (funds {have}, needs {need}).

Restock.Nothing: {shop}: nothing came in this time (failed rolls, or already full)

Edit.Title: Edit shop — {name}
Edit.DropHint: Drop items from a compendium or the sidebar here to stock them. Drop a roll table to roll it and stock the results.
Edit.PerDayHint: Comes back per day. 0 = never, -1 = back to max after a day
Edit.FeaturedHint: Featured (★): shown first in the shop with a star
Edit.EmptyStock: Nothing on the shelf. Add goods in 'Add goods' or drop them here.
Edit.TemplatesHint: Stocks fitting goods for the party level and turns on the matching services. Can be used more than once.
Edit.NoScrollTemplate: No scroll/wand template for that rank.
Edit.ChanceHint: Chance to come back in one restock. Empty: by rarity (Settings tab)
Edit.OneDayHint: Restock once (the shop's rule: fixed amount or chance rolls)

Tpl.Name: Name
Tpl.StepsHint: A template is a list of steps. Each step finds catalog items matching its filters (category, level, rarity, magic) and shelves a random number of them. Levels are relative to the party level (−3 … +2); 'max' is an absolute cap. Empty = no limit.
Tpl.CountHint: How many to pick at random (0 = all that match)
Tpl.HitsHint: Items that match at party level {level}

Set.Title: Shop name
Set.RatesHint: Rules: items usually sell for half their Price (GM Core p. 48); plentiful items 25% or 10%, or refused. Treasure (gems, art) at full price if set.
Set.Resell: Put what players sell on the shelf
Set.AutoRestock: Restock each time a game day passes
Set.RepairHint: The rules give no repair price; the GM sets it. Percent: Price × rate × share of HP lost.
Set.RuneTransfer: Rune transfers (10% of the rune's Price)
Set.RuneHint: Etch runes from the shelf straight onto customers' gear.
Set.ChanceHint: Each period every line secretly rolls d100; within the chance its restock amount comes in. Lines can have their own chance on the Stock tab.
Set.MaterialHint: Multiplies the reforging cost (the difference in value).
Set.WealthApplyHint: Sets the buy/sell rates and the shop's funds to this wealth's suggestion (party level from the Add tab).
Set.PurseHint: Buying from players is paid from this. When it runs out the shop stops buying — so crafting and selling can't print money. It grows when players buy.
Set.MaterialReach: Show materials up to character level +

Ev.Hint: Active events multiply together. With no category ticked an event applies to everything (sell 80% = 20% off; buy 120% = pays more).
Ev.Name: Event name

Manager.Title: Shops
Manager.ChatHint: Post a shop invitation to chat
Manager.DayHint: Restock every shop by one day (game time unchanged)
Manager.TimeHint: Advance game time one day (shops that follow time restock)
Manager.None: No shops yet. Make one with 'New shop'.
Manager.NoneOpen: No shop is open right now.
Manager.Name: Name
Manager.NewHint: A shop is a loot actor. To another world: Export (JSON), or put the actor in a compendium.

Dur.Title: Durability
Dur.Hint: Damage to an item is reduced by its Hardness, then lowers HP. At or below the Broken Threshold it's broken; at 0 destroyed (can't be Repaired). Broken worn armor gets its AC status penalty as an effect (light −1, medium −2, heavy −3). PF2e gives only shields HP — give weapons and armor GM Core material values with 'Material'.
Dur.NoHp: No HP — pick a material to give it durability
Dur.MaterialHint: Hardness/HP/BT from the GM Core material table
Dur.BrokenArmorDesc: Broken armor keeps its item bonus but takes a status penalty to AC (light −1, medium −2, heavy −3). Player Core p. 269.
Dur.GuessHint: Give durability from the suggested material (GM Core: metal weapons and armor are iron or steel)

NoticeState.broken: A broken item doesn't work properly (armor: lower item bonus, shields: no Shield Block). It needs repair.

Settings.TreasureHint: Gems, art objects and other treasure are bought at full Price whatever the shop's rate.
Settings.BrokenArmorHint: Worn broken armor gets its AC status penalty as an effect; removed when repaired.
Settings.PacksHint: Comma-separated pack IDs. Empty: the gear packs the compendium browser uses (translations first).
Settings.RenameRunes: Rename items when runes are etched
Settings.RenameRunesHint: Etching or moving runes at a rune smithy puts the runes in the item's name (e.g. +1 Striking Flaming Longsword). The original name is kept.
Settings.DurMarks: Mark damaged gear on character sheets
Settings.DurMarksHint: Only items that lost Hit Points (damaged, broken, destroyed) get a small mark by their name.
Settings.DurNoticeHint: When an item loses Hit Points, its owners and the GM get a whisper (stressed when it breaks).
Settings.MinionHint: Animals (NPCs) bought at a shop get the minion trait — they act when commanded.

Creature.Hint: Buying creates an NPC actor owned by the character's player (Actors tab, 'Bought Animals' folder). This is a bought animal, not the Animal Companion class feature.
Creature.EditHint: Creatures this shop sells. Find them below in your Actor compendiums (bestiaries). Prices follow the Player Core animals table (riding horse 8 gp, warhorse 30 gp, guard dog 2 sp …), others go by level — change them any time.

Material.LevelHint: Item level of the material — the item takes this level and rarity
Material.Hint: Uses the GM Core precious materials. Cost = value of the same item in the new material − its value now (runes included, as PF2e prices it) × the smithy rate. Hardness/HP change to the material and the material is added to the name (names players gave are kept). The rules have no activity for changing an existing item's material — this is a house rule ('reforging').

MatInfo.adamantine: Extremely hard; gets past resistances only adamantine bypasses.
MatInfo.cold-iron: Extra damage to creatures weak to cold iron (demons, fey …).
MatInfo.silver: Extra damage to creatures weak to silver (devils, werecreatures …).
MatInfo.dawnsilver: Light: less Bulk; armor is easier to wear.
MatInfo.duskwood: Light wood: less Bulk; armor is easier to wear.
MatInfo.dragonhide: Protection against that dragon's damage type.
MatInfo.orichalcum: A weapon can hold one more property rune.

Hint.poor: Few goods (common only), a little dear (110%). Pays 40% and runs out of money fast.
Hint.modest: An ordinary shop. Common goods, sells at 100%, pays 50%.
Hint.rich: 1.5× goods, uncommon items too. Pays 50%, good funds.
Hint.lavish: 2.5× goods, uncommon and rare, levels +2. Luxury prices (105%). Big funds: buys treasure and expensive items.

Cuisine.aleDesc: A mug of ale (Player Core, Basic Services).
Cuisine.teaDesc: A pot of coffee or tea.
Cuisine.poorMealDesc: Bread and thin gruel. Counts as a day's food (Rutz's PF2e Days).
Cuisine.squareMealDesc: A hot, filling meal. Counts as a day's food (Rutz's PF2e Days).
Cuisine.fineDiningDesc: A famous cook's courses. Counts as a day's food (Rutz's PF2e Days).
